jobs.occupation: (Senior) Associate (f/m/d) Deal Financials (Corporate M&A) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description: MAP M&A Deal Financials (DF) is part of the M&A Deal Team for sell-side projects of the Siemens Group and therein responsible for the management of all deal related financial topics. Throughout the entire deal cycle, the team drives and is responsible for all deal related financial topics, such as feasibility study, transaction scoping, business plan and financial modeling and is an integral contributor to the project until Closing.As part of our team, you will have- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AGSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.Our team works in close collaboration with the Senior Management of the target as well as various internal and external experts (including Investment Banks, Tax advisors, Legal professionals, Big4 consultants, Strategy consultants, etc.). We are the key financial experts that handle complex Carve-out and Spin-off transactions such as Siemens Energy, or M&A divestments such as the sale of Flender to Carlyle, Yunex Traffic to Atlantia SpA and Innomotics to KPS Capital Partners. Our tasks include:- Managing the comprehensive preparation of key materials for Financial Due Diligence (e.g., Fact Books and Financial Expert Sessions) supported by the in-house Transaction Support team- Driving the business plan preparation with target management, validating the key planning assumptions, and identifying all adjustments necessary to bring the plan to a standalone / valuation basis- Steering and leading the preparation process of all financial analyses and materials presented to a potential buyer during a transaction process- Being responsible for all financial inputs to the contract negotiations in relation to the Enterprise Value to Equity value bridge, purchase price mechanism, purchase price allocation methodology, working capital definition, and indemnification concepts- Determining the financial implications from divestments on the Siemens Group- Supporting the Carve-out process in financial matters (e.g., determination of internal valuations, deal structuring, evaluating the formation of subgroups and implementing the proper capital structure prior to change of control)You’ll make an impact by - Coordinate teams consisting of internal and external experts and ensure the timely and quality delivery of all financial work packages- Prepare analyses of business models, financial statements and coordinate the presentation of historical financials and business plans for potential investors (e.g., Financial Fact Book, Due Diligence Documents etc.) in collaboration with your team- Support the evaluation and challenging of the business plan and analyze the key assumptions, technical correctness and consistency across all information provided to potential investors (e.g., Information Memorandum, Teaser, Virtual Data Room Documents etc.)- Collaborate in preparing the financial information and analysis required to design financial deal concepts from Carve-out to Closing- Participate in discussions with various experts solving a broad spectrum of complex M&A topics, e.g., selection of deal structure, subgroup structure, target capitalization, contractual structures for internal and external agreements- Be part of the project team preparing key financial inputs for the sale agreement (for example EV-Equity bridge, Working Capital Definition, Deal Structuring, Purchase Price Allocation, Indemnification, Representations & Warranties, etc.)- Contribute to presentations for Siemens Senior Management, serving as a basis for decision-making in M&A transactions- Together with your team, determine the deal financial impact of divestment projects for the Siemens Group on an up-to-date basisThis is how you'll win us over- Education: University degree in Business Administration, Finance or Accounting- Experience & Skills: - Minimum of 5 years of working experience in Investment Banking, M&A Advisory, Transaction Services, Private Equity (preferably in one of the four largest professional services firms worldwide) - Deep analytical and conceptual skills and ability to approach complex financial topics in a structured and pragmatic manner- Strong knowledge in corporate finance, valuation, financial modeling and IFRS Accounting- International working experience is a plus- Strong communication skills, team focus, and you are comfortable working in a highly dynamic and fast-moving environment where you take on responsibility early on- Excellent MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills are required. Basic skills in Power BI, Alteryx, and/or Power Query or other data mining tools are a plus- Ways of working: You are well organized, like to work in teams, and can complete own work packages independently- Languages: Fluent in German and English are a prerequisite for this roleYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.
